text:
lina: Heads-up — my PR #5123 failed docs-preview with two issues: linkcheck (broken anchor to /api/#batching) and a Vale 'WeaselWords' failure on 'just'. CI log: https://ci.redwood.ai/7892

docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR 5123 — checks: linkcheck (1), vale (1), spell (0). See: https://ci.redwood.ai/7892/details

mike: I can take the linkcheck. Is this safe to patch in place or do we need a content owner review?

chris: Reviewer bandwidth low today — if it's a tiny anchor fix, go ahead and merge during docs sprint window (12:00-14:00 PT).

alejandro: @lina can you push a commit that updates the anchor target to the canonical header id? e.g., change '#batching' -> '#batching-and-caching'

sasha: I'll run local linkcheck: run `make docs-linkcheck` then `python -m http.server` if needed. If anyone needs me to land it I can after CI passes :thumbsup:

jp: Vale rule is complaining about 'just' — it's flagged by Writing/WeaselWords. Quickfix: rephrase 'just' -> 'only' or remove it. Prefer removing.

lina: pushing small commit now with both fixes, running linkcheck locally first.

lina: pasted commit message: `Fix: update anchor to '#batching-and-kv-cache' and remove 'just' in server docs`

docs-bot: CI queued — docs-preview started: build 7892

mike: I can approve once docs-preview passes. @chris will you merge during the 12:00 window?

chris: yep, will merge if no regressions. If Vale still fails we should add a quickline exception? prefer rewording though.

alejandro: if we need to suppress temporarily, add a `# nolint: WeaselWords` inline comment in the file with a short rationale, then follow up with an editorial PR.

sasha: linkcheck local output: 1 broken anchor remained — difference was the header had changed from 'KV cache' -> 'KV cache and caching', so commit looks good.

lina: test passed locally, pushed, CI green: all checks passed

docs-bot: docs-preview success for PR 5123 — merging allowed

mike: approving now :white_check_mark:

chris: merged at 12:05 PT. Thanks everyone.
